# Issue 3: Implement basic RoomPlan scanning

## Summary

Add the first RoomPlan capture flow so a user can start, finish, or cancel a scan and receive basic room output.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] User can start a scan
- [ ] User can finish or cancel a scan
- [ ] Scan interruptions are handled
- [ ] Basic room output is captured
- [ ] Errors are shown clearly

## Notes

Depends on hardware and permission checks. Prefer native RoomPlan APIs and do not invent unsupported capture behavior.
